findings.label: S3 grant-helper action breadth
findings.detail: grant_read_write + grant_delete expand to s3:GetBucket*, s3:Abort*, and s3:PutObject* siblings beyond the four actions named in the requirement. All remain scoped to the bucket ARN and bucket/* with no s3:* and no * resource, and the plan explicitly pre-approved the grant-helper approach. Noted for awareness; no change required.
